correctness.rationale: Affine-normalize original ellipsoid to B2^d and outlier to H e1. Solve dr²+(d−1)Hr=1 with 0<r<1/d; exact factorization of the containment slack is (b^-2−a^-2)(s+r)², verifying the entire ball and unique latitude, while H−c=a. Under candidate normalization, apex plus isotropic latitude orbit with weights 1/(d+1), d/(d+1) has mean zero and covariance I/d. Integrating each competitor gives tr(M^-1)≤d; AM–GM forces det M≥1, equality only at candidate, proving universal optimality and uniqueness. Affine untransform gives Q*. Fixed-H and fixed-d limits follow from root expansion. Independently verified factorization and latitude identities with symbolic algebra.
